result.topic_en: Measurement of the magnifications and focal lengths of the astronomical eyepieces of a telescope (the 'Bach' telescope). The magnification is found as the ratio of the tangents of a terrestrial angle seen with the naked eye and through the telescope, and the eyepiece focal lengths are derived from an assumed objective focal length of 756.1 mm.

methods.what: Telescope magnification computed as the ratio of the tangent of half the true angle to the tangent of half the apparent angle measured through the telescope
Eyepiece focal length obtained as the objective focal length divided by the magnification (f_eye = F/M, with F = 756.1)
Separation of the two eyepiece lenses derived from the individual focal lengths and the combined focal length (two-lens combination formula)
